::: typewriter
NIGHT PORTER'S BOOK. Every guest who comes in or goes out after 10 p.m. is written here.
:::

::: handwriting

- 22:15, Mr and Mrs Hollis, room 3, in.
- 23:55, Mr Platt, room 7, in.
- 01:10, Mr Dorey, room 5, asks for a hot water bottle. Taken up.
- 02:20, Mr Platt, room 7, went out by car. 04:05, Mr Platt back, with dust and cobwebs on his coat.
- 04:50, Miss Okafor, room 8, in. Tired.
- 06:30, kitchen fire lit. Milk come.

Nothing else to report. W. Gedge, night porter.
:::

::: stamp
SWAN HOTEL, WICKFOLD
:::
